tokens.name: --ds-color-background
tokens.purpose: The page behind everything. Nothing is painted under it.

tokens.name: --ds-color-border
tokens.purpose: The line that separates one area from another: dividers, table rules, the edge of a panel. The visible edge of a control is a different job and is under review.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger
tokens.purpose: The colour of a message that says something failed, and the fill of an action that destroys something.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-body-text
tokens.group: Status and brand colours painted as text on the page background, as opposed to the *-text tokens above, which sit on a tinted *-surface. The light theme keeps the base colours, which clear AA on the background.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-border
tokens.purpose: The edge of the tinted danger surface.
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-hover
tokens.purpose: The danger fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-soft
tokens.group: Soft destructive fill: the danger red at 10% over the page, with an accessible (AA) dark-red label on top.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-surface
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-danger-text
tokens.group: Status label text for use ON the tinted *-surface tokens (e.g. soft Tag). Dark, saturated in light mode so small text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --ds-color-disabled
tokens.purpose: The fill of a control that cannot be used right now.

tokens.name: --ds-color-emphasis-border
tokens.purpose: The edge of the emphasis area.

tokens.name: --ds-color-emphasis-surface
tokens.purpose: An area that should stand out from the page around it, such as a tooltip or an inverted panel.

tokens.name: --ds-color-focus-halo
tokens.group: Focus indicator: a solid inner ring + a transparent halo of the same color.

tokens.name: --ds-color-focus-ring
tokens.purpose: The colour of the ring that shows where the keyboard is. It needs 3:1 against whatever it is drawn on.

tokens.name: --ds-color-info
tokens.purpose: The colour of a message that tells you something, without anything being wrong.

tokens.name: --ds-color-info-border
tokens.purpose: The edge of the tinted information surface.
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-info-surface
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-info-text
tokens.group: Status label text for use ON the tinted *-surface tokens (e.g. soft Tag). Dark, saturated in light mode so small text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --ds-color-neutral
tokens.purpose: The colour of a message that carries no status at all.

tokens.name: --ds-color-neutral-border
tokens.purpose: The edge that goes with the quiet neutral fill.
tokens.group: Soft primary fill (the "secondary" button): primary at 10% with the full primary as label in light; the label flips to white on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: --ds-color-neutral-surface
tokens.purpose: The quiet fill of a control or chip that carries no status: a plain tag, a default button.
tokens.group: Soft primary fill (the "secondary" button): primary at 10% with the full primary as label in light; the label flips to white on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: --ds-color-neutral-text
tokens.group: Status label text for use ON the tinted *-surface tokens (e.g. soft Tag). Dark, saturated in light mode so small text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-danger-soft
tokens.group: Soft destructive fill: the danger red at 10% over the page, with an accessible (AA) dark-red label on top.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-emphasis
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the emphasis area.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-primary
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the primary fill.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-primary-soft
tokens.group: Soft primary fill (the "secondary" button): primary at 10% with the full primary as label in light; the label flips to white on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-secondary
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the secondary fill.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-selected
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a selected item.
tokens.group: Selection color (checked/selected states). Alias of the secondary (violet); distinct in name from the primary ACTION color, even if both are violet in this theme.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-status
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on a solid status fill: information, success, danger.

tokens.name: --ds-color-on-warning
tokens.purpose: Text and icons drawn on the warning fill. It is dark, because the light warning colour cannot carry white text.

tokens.name: --ds-color-primary
tokens.purpose: The fill of the one action a screen is asking for: the primary button, and the selected state that follows from it.

tokens.name: --ds-color-primary-hover
tokens.purpose: The same fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

tokens.name: --ds-color-primary-soft
tokens.group: Soft primary fill (the "secondary" button): primary at 10% with the full primary as label in light; the label flips to white on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: --ds-color-secondary
tokens.purpose: The fill of an action that is present but not the one being asked for. Same hue as the primary: secondary is a job, not a second colour.

tokens.name: --ds-color-secondary-body-text
tokens.group: Status and brand colours painted as text on the page background, as opposed to the *-text tokens above, which sit on a tinted *-surface. The light theme keeps the base colours, which clear AA on the background.

tokens.name: --ds-color-secondary-hover
tokens.purpose: The secondary fill while the pointer is on it or it is being pressed.

tokens.name: --ds-color-selected
tokens.group: Selection color (checked/selected states). Alias of the secondary (violet); distinct in name from the primary ACTION color, even if both are violet in this theme.

tokens.name: --ds-color-selected-text
tokens.group: Status label text for use ON the tinted *-surface tokens (e.g. soft Tag). Dark, saturated in light mode so small text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --ds-color-success
tokens.purpose: The colour of a message that says something worked.

tokens.name: --ds-color-success-body-text

tokens.name: --ds-color-success-border

tokens.name: --ds-color-surface
tokens.purpose: Anything that sits on the page as its own area: cards, panels, menus, the inside of a field.

tokens.name: --ds-color-surface-hover
tokens.purpose: The same area while the pointer is over it, or while it is the active row of a list.

tokens.name: --ds-color-text
tokens.purpose: Ordinary reading text on background or surface.

tokens.name: --ds-color-text-disabled
tokens.purpose: The text of a control that cannot be used right now. It is exempt from the contrast minimum, so never carry meaning by this colour alone.

tokens.name: --ds-color-text-secondary
tokens.purpose: Text that supports the main text: hints, captions, units. Still has to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --ds-color-warning
tokens.purpose: The colour of a message that says to be careful.

tokens.name: --ds-color-warning-border
tokens.purpose: The edge of the tinted warning surface.
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-warning-surface
tokens.group: Tinted surfaces derived from the feedback hue, mixed into the page.

tokens.name: --ds-color-warning-text
tokens.group: Status label text for use ON the tinted *-surface tokens (e.g. soft Tag). Dark, saturated in light mode so small text clears WCAG AA 4.5:1.
